checks.name: regression-suite
checks.command: cargo test --locked --manifest-path truelearner/Cargo.toml -p truelearner-embodiment -p truelearner-workstation && cargo test --locked --manifest-path academy/Cargo.toml -p academy-body --lib

findings: The retained first post-alignment departure came from Ordinary directional choices, with no admitted transition continuation or completed-cycle reuse.
Gating generic opportunity was insufficient: in outward-middle and outward-near runs, a learned retinal path remained executable and emitted a directional output with opportunity zero.
Removing the centered movement return, alone or with opportunity gating, did not remove that learned-path departure. Both failed arms are retained unchanged.

The v2 candidate places the identity at the common body-effect boundary. A centered eye may retain internal choices and outputs, but its horizontal gaze does not physically move and no movement consequence returns.

All six outward and inward far, middle, and near relations acquired exact joint alignment and held it for every remaining step. The shortest hold was 29 steps and the longest was 47, exceeding the frozen eight-step predicate.
A dark pair still explored horizontally, and centering one eye did not suppress horizontal exploration by the displaced other eye.

Every evidence run replayed exactly, quiesced naturally, remained below the work bound, preserved the semantic firewall, and left the Production visual trace byte-identical at SHA-256 4be6c6f75aefe9dc2f38d019ce0f4f9133b26d650e0016a5b5b051f40241b2af.
residual_uncertainty: This is research-only development evidence for fixation on a centered bright vertical feature; it is not Production adoption or an Academy capability promotion.
Transfer to natural image features, stereo correspondence under clutter or occlusion, depth-directed reaching, and general three-dimensional perception remain unproved.
The physical identity is a foveal body reflex, not a learned decision to fixate; future work must test whether that morphology transfers without becoming over-sticky on natural scenes.
